summary: Snapshot metrics as of 2026-12-02: total pipeline ARR in sheet = 2,447,000 USD; simple sum of Adj Prob-weighted ARR = 1,571,240 USD (weighted by Adj Prob%); at-risk ARR (Adj Prob < 50%) = 1,040,000 USD across 4 accounts; immediate high-priority items (next step due within 7 days) = 4 accounts. Key short actions: procurement packet standardization, exec re-engagement cadence, and compliance artifacts delivery.
methodology: Base Prob% assigned by current stage mapping (Early Renewal 50, Renewal Sent 95, Pilot Success 70, Negotiation 80, Exec Review 85, Legal Review 60, At-risk 30, Upsell 40, Canaries 55). Adjustment rules: subtract 20 pts for Executive Sponsor churn; subtract 15 pts for major regulatory blockers; subtract 10 pts for procurement/legal queue >30 days; add 10 pts for successful pilot or completed technical signoff; floor at 5% and cap at 95%. Weighted ARR = ARR * (Adj Prob% / 100). Notes and flags are used to recommend playbooks and sequence escalation. This sheet is intentionally compact for QBR export and can be expanded into full G-sheet view per account.
playbook_mapping: Commercial discounting playbook = targeted comp plan + 1x PO discount tier; CS lead + AM negotiation template
Executive re-engage playbook = 2-touch exec QBR + CSM + Product VP alignment doc
Contract acceleration playbook = shortened signature packet, pre-approved legal terms, and procurement checklist
Technical integration playbook = eng scoping, connector spec, SLA scoping and timeline
Compliance remediation playbook = deliver KMS/HSM attestations, pen test summary, and audit window commit
Competitive defense playbook = tailored product roadmap demo + short-term pricing incentive
next_steps_observations: Three recurring constraint patterns this week: procurement windows (7 accounts), executive sponsor churn (3 accounts), and compliance artifacts (2 accounts). Recommended operational shifts: (1) curate a 1-page procurement PO packet for legal to pre-approve, (2) add a weekly exec-reengage slot in QBR agenda, and (3) assign a two-person strike team (CS + Solutions Eng) for compliance fast-track cases.
notes: Use this compact matrix during the Dec QBR; export to slide 3 as 'weighted at-risk ARR' visual. Iterate fields next sprint to include probability sensitivity (low/med/high) and an automated next-step reminder via CRM webhook. Owner: Aisha Patel (CS Ops).
